agency: Davao City Information Office / City Health Office
title: Health card issuance starts January 7
supports: The announcement lists a chest x-ray and states a six-month validity period.
The announcement lists urinalysis and fecalysis and states three-month validity periods.
The announcement reports a PHP 50 receipt from the City Treasurer's Office.
The announcement lists a cedula and valid photo ID.
The announcement describes a food-safety seminar certificate for food-industry employees.
The announcement describes a Hepatitis B antibody test for occupations involving exchange of body fluids and the pink-card category.
The announcement says issuance was to begin January 7, 2026, at the fifth floor of Gaisano Ilustre.
limitations: This is a dated announcement, not current confirmation. Current requirements, fees, location, schedule, accepted formats, and occupational categories have not been independently rechecked or approved through the two-person review.

title: Formal Economy Members — Who are Qualified
supports: The page identifies workers in government and private sectors with employee-employer relations as qualified under the direct-contributor program.
limitations: The formal-economy page and its member-category page describe covered worker categories. Their content does not establish first-time enrollment steps, required supporting documents, who files, or the timing of employer onboarding.

title: Be an SSS Member
supports: The page directs people without an SS Number to apply online or through an SSS branch E-Center.

The online application asks applicants to complete registrant verification, basic and contact information, home address, purpose of registration, social status, place of birth, beneficiary details when applicable, and personal-record details before generating the number.
The email link to continue an online application is valid for five calendar days; an expired link requires a new online application.
The procedure permits the applicant to proceed without uploading a supporting document; if the applicant uploads one, the page describes image format and file-size limits.
The page says the employer reports a prospective employee for coverage and that employee coverage takes effect on the first day of employment.
The page does not state an application fee or an employer-specific deadline for obtaining an SS Number.
limitations: The page does not establish that every employer requires the applicant to obtain an SS Number before hiring, nor does it state a fee or employer-specific onboarding deadline. It does not define all eligibility scenarios or prove that the listed data fields are prerequisites for every applicant category. Its optional-upload statement must not be interpreted as a universal document checklist. Whether an existing member needs a new application or a record update should be confirmed with SSS. The source remains unverified pending the project's independent review workflow.

title: List of Valid IDs
supports: The page lists a birth certificate first; alternatives if it is unavailable; and a fallback of any two listed documents when the earlier documents are unavailable, with both showing the correct name and at least one showing date of birth.
limitations: This page does not say that every listed document must be uploaded during an initial SS Number application. The application guidance says supporting-document upload is optional. Confirm which identity evidence applies to the specific transaction with SSS. This source remains unverified pending the project's independent review workflow.

title: Online Services
supports: PhilHealth lists online access to member records, contributions, and the Member Data Record, including viewing or printing the MDR.
PhilHealth describes the Electronic Premium Remittance System as enabling employers to remit premium contributions online.
limitations: The page describes access to existing member information and employer contribution remittance, not first-time enrollment, required documents, or responsibility for enrolling an employee.

agency: Congress of the Philippines / Official Gazette
title: Republic Act No. 11261 — First Time Jobseekers Assistance Act
evidenceType: Official Gazette publication page and linked PDF; article metadata reviewed
supports: The Official Gazette article identifies Republic Act No. 11261, gives its signing date as April 10, 2019, and links a PDF bearing the Act number.
limitations: The Official Gazette article page and PDF link were accessible, but the PDF text itself was not extracted or reviewed in this research. Exact section wording was cross-checked only against the Lawphil transcription at https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11261_2019.html, which is not an official source and cannot establish the statutory claims. An independent reviewer must inspect the official PDF, check current amendments and implementation, and confirm the Act's conditions and exceptions before approving any legal guidance.

title: Official NBI Clearance portal
supports: The page title identifies the destination as OFFICIAL NBI CLEARANCE and is hosted on the clearance.nbi.gov.ph government subdomain.
limitations: The retrieved page is a JavaScript application shell and does not expose its current transaction instructions in this review. Applicant eligibility, required documents, booking steps, fees, processing time, Davao office details, and implementation of Republic Act No. 11261 remain unconfirmed. The destination identity is not evidence that a particular applicant qualifies or that a fee is waived.

title: Citizen's Charter — NBI Clearance Application
supports: The page identifies the service as NBI Clearance Processing and Issuance for the public and lists two valid government-issued identification cards.
The page describes walk-in, online without e-payment, and online with e-payment service paths, including biometric and image capture and clearance printing.
The page links the online-with-e-payment option to https://clearance.nbi.gov.ph/.
limitations: The page does not state a publication or effective date. Its listed fee amounts (PHP 115, PHP 165, PHP 415) are not explained by transaction category or a currentness date and are not suitable for publication as current fees. Its address and schedule describe the NBI Clearance and Identification Center in Manila and do not confirm a Davao service office or local procedure. Confirm the current charter and applicable Davao instructions before relying on its requirements, steps, fees, location, or timing.

title: Membership Registration
supports: The official Pag-IBIG Fund membership-registration URL was identified, but the page returned a browser-verification challenge during this review.
limitations: No registration steps, applicant category, documents, contribution rules, fees, timing, employer responsibility, or first-time employee applicability could be confirmed from the challenged page. This record is only a research lead; confirm current instructions with Pag-IBIG before acting.

title: Online Registration and Update System (ORUS)
supports: The official BIR ORUS URL returned an application shell titled ORUS.
limitations: The retrieved shell contains no visible TIN registration instructions. The correct employee registration route, employer/applicant responsibilities, required information, fees, timing, and the application of Republic Act No. 11261 remain unconfirmed. Do not treat this portal link as a complete registration procedure.

title: Philippine Statistics Authority official website
supports: The PSA URL was requested as a candidate civil-registry document reference, but a transport-level DNS or connection failure prevented retrieval; no procedure claim is supported.
limitations: The page title, current URL validity, request channels, eligibility, documents, fees, delivery, authorized representatives, and current birth-certificate process were not confirmed. Treat this as an unverified research lead, not instructions.
